precommitted_interpretation_checks: Quarterly GAAP revenue rises 6.5 USD million while expenses fall 2.7, yielding operating income +9.2; do not substitute the separate full-year revenue outlook for actual quarterly results.
Total other expense becomes 1.3 USD million more negative, so pre-tax income rises only 7.9. Tax provision falls 9.6 and net income rises 17.5. The +17.5 is not wholly operating-income improvement.
Diluted EPS rises 0.37 to 0.43 USD/share while diluted weighted-average shares fall 329.6 to 322.8 million. EPS improvement is not a pure business-growth measure.
Q3 source statement includes Nine Months Ended columns and a separate 2025 outlook table. Select only Three Months Ended September 30, 2025 actuals and preserve USD millions versus per-share units.
Adjacent-quarter accounting comparisons do not establish causal durability, valuation or a trade.
